senses.zh_definition: 若原文用于指人，则为专名 Mona，通常音译为“莫娜”；现有数据不能确定具体人物或其他词义。
senses.en_definition: Provisionally, the personal name Mona; the intended referent and any other lexical interpretation remain unconfirmed.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk kepada seseorang, Mona ialah nama khas; rujukan sebenar bentuk dalam paket ini belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 不能把专名用法当作 DBP 已确认的普通词义。官方马来语文本中可见 Mona 作为姓名，但这并不能确定本数据项的所指。以下为自拟姓名用例，搭配不是固定搭配，频率未经核实。[马来西亚国会记录](https://hansard.parlimen.gov.my/hansard/dewan-rakyat/2026-07-07)

etymology.historical_story: A personal name can enter Malay discourse through an ordinary introduction, a news report, or a document while retaining its own naming history. The spelling Mona alone does not establish that history. Without an identified bearer or source passage, assigning one language of origin or a traditional name meaning would go beyond the available evidence.
